prague-bohemia-bohemian-switzerland-gorg.story: A proper escape from Prague with roads worth waking up for. Out of Neratovice and back again: 245 km, roughly 5 h 07 in the saddle. scenicChapters.narrative: 35 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10 → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-regensburg-gro-prufening-kastell-.story: A 216 km round trip from Sinzing - roughly 3 h 43 in the saddle. On the way it passes Fort site of Eining-Unterfeld, Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10, Fort site of Burgsalach and back through Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10. The line favours views over speed.
